hpe_baseline_drift.oem_guide_title: Deploying and updating VMware ESXi on HPE ProLiant Gen10 Plus Servers (a00061651enw)

drifts.rationale: NUMA Group Size Optimization is set to Clustered (Clustered). Virtualization-Max Performance profile recommends Flat.
drifts.citation: HPE UEFI Workload-based Performance and Tuning Guide (881335-002)

rules.rationale: Workload Profile is set to Custom (Custom). Allows selective tuning of power regulators, sub-NUMA clustering, and C-states. Recommended when fine-tuning for OS-controlled power (VSI-HPM) or disabling SNC for vSAN clusters.
rules.citation: HPE UEFI Workload-based Performance and Tuning Guide (881335-002)

rules.rationale: Power Regulator is set to Static High-Performance Mode. CPU operates at maximum frequency without dynamic frequency modulation.
rules.citation: HPE Deploying and updating VMware ESXi on HPE servers (a00061651enw, Step 1)

rules.rationale: Processor Core C-States are Disabled (No C-states). Prevents core sleep states, eliminating wake-up latency for deterministic low jitter.
rules.citation: HPE Deploying and updating VMware ESXi on HPE servers (a00061651enw, Step 1)

rules.rationale: Energy-Efficient Turbo is Disabled (forced by Virtualization-MaxPerformance). Turbo frequencies are not opportunistically throttled by energy-efficiency algorithms.
rules.citation: HPE UEFI Workload-based Performance and Tuning Guide (881335-002)

rules.rationale: Hardware-assisted CPU virtualization is Enabled. Required for ESXi 64-bit guest virtual machine execution.
rules.citation: VMware vSphere 9.1 Performance Best Practices, Hardware-Assisted CPU Virtualization (VT-x and AMD-V™) (p. 12)

rules.rationale: Directed I/O virtualization (VT-d / AMD IOMMU) is Enabled (or Auto). Required for PCI pass-through, vSAN Direct, and DPU/SmartNIC operations.
rules.citation: VMware vSphere 9.1 Performance Best Practices, Hardware-Assisted I/O MMU Virtualization (VT-d and AMD-Vi) (p. 12)

rules.rationale: Logical Processor (Hyper-Threading / SMT) is Enabled. Exposes maximum logical execution contexts to ESXi CPU scheduler.
rules.citation: VMware vSphere 9.1 Performance Best Practices, Hyper-Threading Considerations (p. 19)

rules.setting_name: Processor Turbo Boost / Core Performance Boost
rules.rationale: Processor Turbo Boost is Enabled. Allows opportunistic execution frequency scaling above nominal TDP baseline.
rules.citation: VMware vSphere 9.1 Performance Best Practices, Turbo Boost (p. 23)

rules.rationale: SR-IOV is Enabled (forced by Virtualization-MaxPerformance). Allows PCIe NICs to expose hardware Virtual Functions (VFs).
rules.citation: HPE UEFI Workload-based Performance and Tuning Guide (881335-002)

rules.rationale: NUMA Group Size Optimization is set to Clustered (Clustered). Virtualization-Max Performance profile recommends Flat.
rules.citation: HPE UEFI Workload-based Performance and Tuning Guide (881335-002)

rules.rationale: Sub-NUMA Clustering is Disabled. Avoids partitioning physical sockets into multiple smaller NUMA domains, preserving standard 1-node-per-socket memory locality for vSAN ESA and general VMs.
rules.citation: HPE Solutions for SAP HANA and VMware vSAN on DL380 Gen11 (a50016126enw)

rules.rationale: System Boot Mode is configured for UEFI. Mandatory for VCF 9.1, modern NVMe pass-through, and TPM 2.0 measurement.
rules.citation: VMware vSphere 9.1 Performance Best Practices, System BIOS and Platform Firmware (p. 17)
